note: A model of speaking time, used while authoring to catch a vault that is running long. It is not a stopwatch and has never been timed against a recording. Only leaving the band fails the score; the target is advice.

basis.words_per_minute: 150 is the standard conversational presenting rate. Faster than that and a non native English speaker in the audience loses the thread.
basis.seconds_per_code_line: 1.2 is the marginal cost of a line once the cell is introduced. A fifteen line schema is shown, not read out.
basis.seconds_per_output_block: 9 covers pointing at a result and drawing the conclusion from it.
basis.seconds_per_code_cell: 15 covers introducing a cell and saying what it is for, before any line is read.
